mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.user_id AS userId, o.seat_id AS seatId, s.seat_code AS seatCode, o.room_id AS roomId, r.room_name AS roomName, f.floor_num AS floorNum, o.booking_date AS bookingDate, o.start_time AS startTime, o.end_time AS endTime, o.status AS status, CASE o.status WHEN 0 THEN '待签到' WHEN 1 THEN '进行中' WHEN 2 THEN '已完成' WHEN 3 THEN '已取消' WHEN 4 THEN '已爽约' END AS statusText, o.checkin_time AS checkinTime, o.checkout_time AS checkoutTime, o.remark AS remark, o.create_time AS createTime FROM booking_order o LEFT JOIN study_seat s ON s.seat_id = o.seat_id LEFT JOIN study_room r ON r.room_id = o.room_id LEFT JOIN library_floor f ON f.floor_id = r.floor_id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND o.user_id = #{userId}
